data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'maribah', meaning 'gentle, tender, kind'. This name symbolizes softness, compassion, and sensitivity in Islam. The name Marib carries the meaning “Gentle, tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Marib usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is a reminder of the importance of treating others with tenderness, compassion, and understanding – traits that are highly valued in Muslim communities.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, Marib represents the sublime and compassionate essence of God (Allah) that is all-embracing, all-loving, and endlessly forgiving. The name serves as a reminder of the transcendent and tender mercy of Allah towards His creation and the high moral character that is expected of Muslims as they strive to embody this divine quality. By choosing the name Marib, one seeks to honor and live in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and the love and compassion present in the Islamic tradition.
